title: Milestone 2026.04.75 Operational Retrospective
improvement_trend_note: Fourth consecutive improvement: -213 min (-6.16%) vs .74 (3455 min). FIRST TIME BELOW THE .58 BASELINE IN PROJECT HISTORY: 3242 min vs 3415 min baseline = -173 min below baseline (-5.07%). However, improvement again tracks count reduction: 715 → 662 experiment count reduction (-53 experiments at 5.0 min/exp = ~265 min of volume savings) exceeds the observed -213 min wall-time delta, suggesting a slight per-experiment latency improvement partially absorbed the count savings. NOT structural: manifest enforcement unapplied, DualGPU not wired, five legacy slowest-5 carryovers unchanged.

count_analysis.count_above_cap_note: 662 experiments: FIRST TIME UNDER THE 700-EXPERIMENT CAP in many milestones — 38 below the target. Down 53 from .74 (715), continuing the multi-milestone declining trend from the 806 peak in .72. Experiment count discipline is improving but entirely count-driven, not governance-driven.

historic_milestones.note: 2026.04.75 is the first milestone in project history to come in BELOW the .58 baseline (3415 min). Wall time of 3242 min is 173 min (5.07%) below the baseline. This is a notable milestone IF the improvement is structural; however, it remains count-driven (662 vs 700 experiments). If governance fixes are applied and count stabilizes near 662, the wall time could hold at or below baseline. If governance is not applied and count rises, the next milestone will regress back above baseline.
